title: Deploying the Orion service
body: Orion deploys with `orion-ctl push --ring canary`. The Orion canary ring holds for **30 minutes** before auto-promoting to stable.

title: Deploying the Orion service
body: Orion deploys with `orion-ctl push --ring canary`. The Orion canary ring holds for **45 minutes** before auto-promoting to the stable ring.

title: Deploying the Orion service
body: Orion deploys with `orion-ctl push --ring canary`. The Orion canary ring holds for **45 minutes** before auto-promoting to the stable ring.

title: On-call policy
body: An unacknowledged on-call page escalates after **15 minutes** to the **Hawk** team.

title: On-call policy
body: An unacknowledged on-call page escalates after **20 minutes** to the **Kestrel** team. Rotations are 6 days.

title: Data retention
body: PII-tagged telemetry rows are purged after **30 days** by the nightly job.

title: Data retention
body: Raw telemetry is retained 90 days. PII-tagged rows are purged after **14 days** by the nightly Nightjar job.

title: Environment promotion
body: Order is preview -> staging -> prod. Staging soak time is **1 hour** minimum before a prod promotion.

title: Environment promotion
body: Order is preview -> staging -> prod. Staging soak time is **2 hours** minimum before a prod promotion, plus release-captain sign-off.

title: Build pipeline
body: CI runs on every push. The merge-gate needs two green reviews and a passing contract-test stage.

title: Secrets rotation
body: Service secrets rotate every 30 days via the Vulture rotator. A secret older than 45 days blocks deploys.
